title: AI assistants are becoming a shop front, and our store must be ready
summary: Amazon added 100+ Alexa for Shopping functions and text-to-shop; Walmart's Sparky builds carts; OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles; Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping tests; Samsung sees memory shortage through 2028.

points.headline: Amazon and Walmart turn AI assistants into full shopping channels
points.detail: Alexa for Shopping gained 100+ functions, merchant onboarding and text-based shopping; Walmart's Sparky now builds carts. We should check how our products and feeds surface in these assistants.

points.headline: Agent checkout is unreliable and regulation is coming
points.detail: Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping test runs, and an EU draft law ties agent autonomy to commercial incentives. We should test agent journeys on our store and track the rules.

points.headline: OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles
points.detail: Claimable profiles and new agents for US e-commerce firms give brands some control over how they appear in AI answers. We should evaluate claiming a profile for our store.

points.headline: Memory squeeze persists while PC OEMs trim 2027 buys
points.detail: Samsung sees the memory shortage lasting through 2028, while TrendForce says rising inventories lead some PC OEMs to adjust 2027 memory plans. We should watch pricing and secure supply.

points.headline: Amazon fees and Cyber 5 exclusives raise marketplace stakes
points.detail: Amazon seller fees and ads hit $66.1B in Q3, and Amazon touts record Black Friday and Cyber Monday exclusives. We should weigh marketplace margin against our own store offers.
